provider: 豆包云盘 Doubao Drive (ByteDance; storage provided by 北京飞书科技)

free_tier.stated: The stated allowance is deliberately unquantified: '豆包通过云盘功能向普通账号提供一定额度的免费云存储空间'. Reported reality: legacy users 100 GB, new users 10 GB, API reports 5 TB but that is decorative. '注：抓包/facade/get_user_storage会显示5TB空间，但实测为上限为100G'. A 2026-06 protocol revision added paid expansion on top of the free allowance.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.notes: extracted from the quota or limits prose

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: extraction found no retention clause; the seed's limits text may still state one, see extras.limits_verbatim

egress.terms: Not applicable at these sizes; downloads are CDN-served with no published meter.

tooling: OpenList driver `doubao` (cookie auth, download_api select get_file_url/get_download_info, 2 r/s client-side rate limit). Reverse-engineered and explicitly unmaintained ('本接口是基于历史产物的逆向接口').
chaining: ByteDance account per phone number, 10–100 GB each. The 5 TB figure in the API is exactly the 'unlimited that isn't' trap from §3.
limits_note: quota: 100 GB for legacy accounts, 10 GB new. per-object-cap: '上传限制300MB，但是去除一个get参数' can be raised. The 5 TB API value does not correspond to usable capacity.
reliability_note: Quota direction is downward (AI-space free tier was cut to 5 TB then to 100 GB); the interface is unofficial and the 'unlimited' banner has already been retired.
confidence_note: mechanically converted from the seed corpus; no page was read for this record in the storage-dossier pass. One page read moves it to documented.
